Legacy hazards and ordinary enemies need observation of damage dispatch still unwinding after cancellation/death callbacks.
Runtime callback guards must validate world/player/actor lifetimes before typed calls; private room transform and source pose remain bound.
Current-world hostile legacy projectile with a living but no-longer-owned source still poses danger; it cannot be silently skipped.
Live source prompt obstruction must include the stationary hive layer as authoritative save already does.
LootPlacement body/route mask1 missed actual live hive layer16. Narrow1|16 fix and native before/after-destruction regression; floor mask1 preserved.
Early pet securing must not backfill newly inferred completion-count achievements in old profiles; preserve previously earned entries and legitimate findings.
Recovery cleanup must not read an invalid party or restore input/modal state after losing ownership; newly attached Sanctuary still needs native admission.
Prompt measurement used font16 while rendering scaled font. Narrow same-font-size correction awaits native geometry checks.
fixture_scope: Normal middle checkpoints require real local combat deaths. Zero-kill XP is a narrow calculation boundary, not falsely claimed zero-kill integration.
Shared setup must never probe secure_early on an already-clear spring and accidentally commit it.
Preserved159 modes retain the accepted corrected post-idle pet observer and physical demo-exchange storage paths.
